newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland becomes member of IMF's new data standard.
newsitem.headline: Ireland becomes member of IMF's new data standard.

text.p: Ireland said on Thursday that it is one of less than 20 inaugural members of the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) new standard for the publication of economic and financial data.
The standard, known as the special data dissemination standard (SDSS), requires member countries to publish a wide range of important statistical data.

Irish finance minister Ruairi Quinn said in a statement that membership of the standard was an important indicator to financial markets of the reliability and accessibility of Ireland's financial and economic data.
It should enhance our reputation as a high quality sovereign borrower, Quinn said in a statement.
